Who I Am
Educator.
Builder.
Entrepreneur.

I am a Licensed Professional Teacher (LPT) and MBA graduate with over 7 years teaching business subjects under DepEd since 2017. I build AI-powered systems, conduct business consulting, and manage social media for real clients.

I built DALIguro — a working AI teacher support platform — and PartsFlow Pro — a live inventory and sales system — both from real firsthand experience. As Founder of Asenso Gas One, I have developed franchise packages, ads, and a 1K-follower Facebook presence. I manage social media and ads for PrimeShade Auto Tint in Capiz, Iloilo, and Aklan.

I build using Claude Code and Codex in parallel — running both simultaneously to accelerate development, debug faster, and ship better workflows. This is how DALIguro and PartsFlow Pro were built without a full engineering team. I plan and analyze; the AI handles execution speed. That combination is what makes my systems real, not theoretical.

Based in Maayon, Capiz, Philippines. Everything I build starts from actual workflow pain, not theory.
